description: This file defines a PHP class TCPDFBarcode that generates array representations for various 1D barcode types used with TCPDF, including methods for encoding different barcode standards and converting binary sequences to barcode arrays.

classes.name: TCPDFBarcode
classes.description: A class for creating array representations of various 1D barcodes for use with TCPDF, including encoding and conversion methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the barcode object with a code and type, setting up the barcode array.

methods.name: getBarcodeArray
methods.description: Returns the generated barcode array representation.

methods.name: setBarcode
methods.description: Sets the barcode array based on the provided code and barcode type, calling specific encoding methods.

methods.name: barcode_code39
methods.description: Generates a Code 39 barcode array, with options for extended mode and checksum.

methods.name: encode_code39_ext
methods.description: Encodes a string for Code 39 extended mode.

methods.name: checksum_code39
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for Code 39 barcodes.

methods.name: barcode_code93
methods.description: Generates a Code 93 barcode array.

methods.name: checksum_code93
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for Code 93 barcodes.

methods.name: barcode_s25
methods.description: Generates a Standard 2 of 5 barcode array, with optional checksum.

methods.name: binseq_to_array
methods.description: Converts a binary sequence into a barcode array.

methods.name: barcode_i25
methods.description: Generates an Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode array, with optional checksum.

methods.name: barcode_codabar
methods.description: Generates a CODABAR barcode array.

methods.name: barcode_code11
methods.description: Generates a CODE 11 barcode array.

methods.name: barcode_eanupc
methods.description: Generates EAN or UPC barcode array based on length parameter.

methods.name: barcode_postnet
methods.description: Generates POSTNET or PLANET barcode array for postal codes.

methods.name: barcode_imb
methods.description: Generates an Intelligent Mail Barcode (IMB) array, requiring PHP bcmath extension.

methods.name: dec_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a large decimal number to hexadecimal string, using bc math extension.

methods.name: hex_to_dec
methods.description: Converts a large hexadecimal string to decimal, using bc math extension.

methods.name: imb_crc11fcs
methods.description: Calculates the Frame Check Sequence for IMB.

methods.name: imb_reverse_us
methods.description: Reverses bits in a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: imb_tables
methods.description: Generates lookup tables for IMB encoding.
